svg.title: Helios-Artemis system flowchart
svg.desc: Full system flow for the Helios-Artemis dual-MCU predictive MPPT controller, showing boot, sensor acquisition, LSTM inference, UART exchange, P&O MPPT, CC/CV/Float charging FSM, SD logging, web dashboard, and TF.js retraining pipeline.
